name: Турецкая тетрадь
summary: In the documentary series "Turkish Notebook", Vladimir Pozner will try to solve the mystery of Istanbul, delve into the history of the Ottoman Empire, study the phenomenon of Ataturk and much more. The author will present his subjective view of the past and present of Turkey.

name: First lady
summary: David Batra embarks on a journey to become the best possible first lady he can be. How do you behave and what do you actually do?. Follow along from the first reception in the Ticino palace in the spring of 2023 - until the Kinberg Batra couple move out of the residence prematurely in the fall of 2024.

name: Love Is Blind: Argentina
summary: In this groundbreaking reality series, men and women pop the question to their soulmates — all while having no idea of what they actually look like.

name: Forræder - Ukendt grund
summary: 17 very different players from all over Denmark occupy the 'Traitor' castle in the ultimate game of truths and lies. The game is full of surprises and drama: Who is loyal, who is a traitor - and who ends up taking home the big cash prize at the end?

name: Politierechters
summary: In Politierechters everyone who has committed an offence is tackled before the judge, and we also get a unique look behind the scenes of the court.

name: Taming the Bad Boy
summary: From his very first day at his new school, Jin-woo draws everyone's attention. Among them is Tae-seop, who approaches Jin-woo out of curiosity. As his curiosity grows uncontrollable, rumors begin spreading at school about who might be gay… "From now on, you're my little pet."

name: Misplacement
summary: Songstress Shen Zhiqiu, determined to uncover the truth behind her abandonment by her sister years ago, carefully schemes to get close to the young master of the Yin family. However, she unexpectedly ends up in an arranged engagement with the third master, Yin Heng. In the perilous Yin household, Shen Zhiqiu and her sister find redemption and reconciliation. Meanwhile, her relationship with Yin Heng evolves from mutual exploitation to genuine love. Together, they orchestrate a grand and dazzling act of revenge.

name: San Xian Mi Hui
summary: A mysterious mutation plagues the Water Demon Clan, compelling Yi Sa and Zong Hang to dive into a perilous underwater journey. As ancient secrets surface and hidden powers awaken, they are drawn into a breathtaking world where danger, love, and the cycle of reincarnation intertwine.

name: Áit a dTéann na Géanna Fiáine
Where the Wild Geese Go
summary:
Where the Wild Geese Go is a fantastic adventure and a fun project that is all about following the amazing Light-Bellied Brent Goose as it embarks on an incredible trip. Little is known about our feathered friends, and we want to find out more, so a team of scientists have been assembled to track the geese from Ireland to Canada and back again.   

This project brings you inside the flock to see these amazing birds in action, and as they travel, you'll also find out more about the different places they visit and the diverse people they meet.  So, we're calling all Goose Detectives to grab your binoculars and join us as we take off on this epic journey. Visit rte.ie/goose to log your sightings and to find out more.

name: Fictional
summary: Fictional follows the story of Jinbo, a young man who unexpectedly reunites with a senior he once admired. As they begin living together, their relationship deepens, leading to unexpected twists. Naoya Shimizu, known for his roles in ‘The Boy with Dead Eyes' and ‘Wakamusha', stars as Jinbo, a character who is constantly at the mercy of his enigmatic senior. Bun Kimura, best known for his work in ‘Chimudondon' and ‘Tokyo Vice', plays the mysterious senior who harbors a hidden secret.

name: Me, Him and You
summary: "That encounter surely changed my life." Takumi, who aspires to become a chef, has no place to live when the restaurant where he was working as a live-in chef went out of business. He was looking for a new job, but was rejected. Then, he is surprised to find a certain person in a coffee shop he entered. Inside the store were Ryoji, a photographer; Daiya, a model; and Soichiro - Daiya's uncle. Takumi recalls his past love at first sight for Ryoji and the words he said to him at that time.... "How do you want to live?" Ryoji does not remember at all, and Takumi has been living his life hiding the fact that he loves men. Ryoji and Daiya, who are friends, try to share a room, but due to cost issues, they are looking for another tenant. Daiya, who has a good sense of humor, welcomes Takumi, whom he has never met before, as the third member of the group. Takumi, who unexpectedly ends up living with the person he loves, Ryoji, who is not serious about love, and Daiya, who seems to be living a carefree life. What is the happy future that the three will face?

name: Blue Complex
summary: After leaving diving behind due to a traumatic experience, Im Pa-rang, a former silver medalist, joins the university swimming team. There, he finds himself caught in a complex journey of love and self-discovery with two men, Taemin and Yubin.

name: Red Whisper
summary: The story centers on Suyol, who is deeply committed to her relationship with Ajin. However, unbeknownst to her, Ajin is secretly having with an affair with a man named Jaehyun. As Suyol remains blissfully unaware of the betrayal, her close friend Harry struggles with her own hidden feelings for Suyol. Will Suyol's world come crashing down when she discovers the truth about Ajin's affair? And could this painful revelation open the door for Harry to finally confess her love?

name: Tendering Resignation
summary: The drama follows Oh Geumhui, a hardworking woman who sometimes comes across as a workaholic. She leads a seemingly normal life, working at her longtime close friend Kang Taeri's company. When a new employee mistakenly assumes she and Taeri are lesbians and quits, the competent Yu Bora steps in. As strange events unfold, the trio discovers that Nosong Group is behind it all. How will they navigate these challenges together?

name: Papás por Conveniencia
summary: Papás por Conveniencia follows single father Tino and successful businesswoman Aidé as they form a family born out of convenience when Tino discovers he is the father of Aidé's twin teenagers. Tino takes a job with Aidé to get to know his children, but his family's move into Aidé's home creates a chaotic environment, forcing them to navigate their complex relationship while overcoming obstacles to find true love and happiness.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2 - Mi compañero de vida

name: Nineteen
summary: The story captures the essence of teenage years, portraying the most vivid and unforgettable moments of a young girl's life. It delves into the excitement and emotions of first love, as 19-year-old girls navigate the complexities of friendship and romance, experiencing those indescribable feelings that come with growing up.

name: Ghostbreakers
summary: A group of bumbling paranormal investigators goes to spooky places and gets entangled in bizarre, inane, and absurd nocturnal misadventures.

name: Billionaire Apocalypse
summary: In Billionaire Apocalypse the richest man on the planet, 200 of his employees, and his family are forced to flee to his private island in the wake of a global financial collapse, where the employees and family members — who he's treated as afterthoughts for decades — quickly realize he's no longer rich and thus no longer in charge.

name: Familier som vores
summary: In a not-too-distant future, Denmark faces total evacuation due to rising water levels. As the nation prepares to leave their homes, high school student Laura must choose between her divorced parents and the boy she's fallen in love with.

name: Ms. Murder
summary: Uncover three shocking stories of women whose seemingly ordinary lives are upended by questionable deaths.

name: Motorway Cops USA
summary: Characterful documentary series about New Jersey police as they crack down on dangerous drivers. As officers police the roads, discover the humans - and the humour - behind the badge. Dashcam shows the devastation America's worst drivers cause.

name: Chateau DIY: Living the Dream
summary: Chateau DIY: Living the Dream follows up with chateau owners who appeared on the main series of Chateau DIY. Each episode focuses on one chateau and tell the owners' story from the beginning to the current day, following their extensive renovations and business ventures as well as their plans for the future.

name: Apocalyptic Kitchen
summary: Everyone's favourite auntie Deva is on a mission to teach the kids life skills.

previousepisode.name: Deva, Julie & JD SHORE Rum - This should be interesting!

name: On the Ladder with Kiwibank
summary: Host Brodie Kane joins eight house-buying groups from around NZ as they navigate getting on the ladder. Whether it's a family home, dream do-up or the perfect investment, these whānau & friends are pursuing co-ownership as a way to property success.

name: Above the Fold with Jemele Hill
summary: Above the Fold with Jemele Hill will deliver a comprehensive and engaging exploration of diverse stories inside the sports world.

name: 900 días sin Anabel
summary: Anabel Segura's abduction held Spain in suspense for 900 days. This docuseries explores the case through never-before-heard recordings of the kidnappers.

name: Rock Goes to College
summary: Featuring the best of contemporary British and American Rock Bands. Each week's recording takes place on a college campus in front of an audience of students.

name: Jazz Goes to College
summary: A series presenting the best in international jazz recorded in concert from Britain's foremost colleges and universities.

name: Big Zuu and AJ Tracey's Rich Flavours
summary:
BAFTA award-winning TV chef Big Zuu is teaming up with his cousin and multi-platinum selling rapper AJ Tracey, for a global culinary experience like no other in Sky Max's new original series Big Zuu & AJ Tracey's Seriously Rich Flavours, set to air in spring 2025.

This three-part series takes viewers on an exciting journey to explore the world's most expensive and outrageous dishes. But the dynamic duo won't just be sampling the food – they'll be immersing themselves in the culture, customs and stories surrounding these unique dining experiences, offering a glimpse into the world of ludicrous luxury. Travelling across East Asia, North America and Europe, this extravagant culinary investigation sees Big Zuu and AJ Tracey uncover the places and people behind these premium plates.

name: Norske Truckers
summary: We follow six dedicated truck drivers who have made more than just a career choice – they have chosen a lifestyle on the road. They show us their everyday lives with heavy loads and long hours behind the wheel.

name: The Beginning After the End
summary: A king is reborn as Arthur Leywin in a magical world and seeks to correct the mistakes of his past life.

name: Toon In with Me
summary: Cartoons, sketches, and pop culture.

name: Irreversível
summary: A tormented psychologist, Júlia Mendes, and a determined inspector, Pedro Sousa, team up to solve a brutal murder of a young girl in a coastal town. As they solve the crime, they battle their own demons and try to keep their lives intact. In a city where everyone is hiding something and is willing to do anything to protect their loved ones, the search for the truth may cost more than Julia imagines, since from the moment the secrets of the past are revealed, everything becomes irreversible. Does love justify everything?

name: Beast Boy: Lone Wolf
summary: Action-comedy shorts follow Beast Boy, embarking on his first solo adventures, proving he can be a superhero without the Teen Titans – even if no one believes him!

name: Útközben elmeséled - Csavargások Svábyval
summary: Tell Me Along the Way is a talk show sprinkled with road movie elements, which not only takes viewers on a journey through the landscapes of Hungary but also promises plenty of excitement. András Sváby and his celebrity guest leave modern technology behind, hop into a camper van, and embark on a two-day trip, where adventures and friendly conversations take center stage. The host takes his companions to places that have played an important role in their lives, while also giving them tasks that push them out of their comfort zones. They spend the night in the camper or a tent, and András Sváby takes care of dinner. Beautiful landscapes, honest moments, challenges, campfires, cooking, a camper van, no gadgets — this is what Tell Me Along the Way has in store for viewers. The guests will include Róbert Alföldi, Péter Geszti, Mariann Falusi, Csaba "Cyla" Kajdi, László Lakatos, Réka Rubint, Győző Szabó, and Liliána Szilágyi.

name: Brigada Nimic
summary: In a humorous approach, the series follows the small and insignificant cases that the policemen of the Nothing Brigade: Arrow, Giovanni, Carmola and Toma have to solve.

name: Tokyo Override
summary: When a lonely hacker gets entangled with a group of underground couriers, they uncover the dark truth lurking beneath Tokyo's seemingly perfect facade.

name: Witch Hat Atelier
summary:
Coco, a humble dressmaker's daughter, has always been fascinated by magic and the witches who cast it, despite the strict precautions they take to hide their methods from the public. However, when Coco takes advantage of a golden chance to spy on the skilled witch Qifrey, she realizes that her favorite picture book was a disguised magic book all along! In her excitement, she immediately starts testing out the various spells.

When a spell causes a disaster in her home, Qifrey rescues her just in time and decides to train her, realizing that she is the first lead he has found that could help him track down the Brimmed Caps—a dangerous group of heretics who experiment with forbidden body-altering magic and spread magical artifacts among the commoners. But before Coco and Qifrey can confront the Brimmed Caps, she is going to have to improve her magical skills and learn to get along with Qifrey's other apprentices.

name: Asaf
summary: Asaf is an ordinary driver with strong moral values, trying to find a way to get his life back on track after his separation from his wife and son. Following an unfortunate traffic accident, he gets entangled with the wrong people and finds himself sucked into a world of mystery. His life will never be the same.

name: The Other Me
summary: Xiao Xue, a delivery driver, unexpectedly crosses paths with Song Yuxian, the heiress of Song Group, and discovers that they look strikingly alike. They quickly become close friends, each envious of the other's life. Meanwhile, Song Yuxian's husband, Xia Qingyang, the CEO of Song Group, is deeply troubled. He seems to know everything about Xiao Xue.

name: Fortune Awaits
summary: This story tells of an ordinary person barely managing a pig farm and a privileged billionaire heir who swap lives. He Fang, the pig farm owner, looks exactly like Jin Xiao, the second son of the Jim's Group. These two unrelated individuals accidentally swap identities, forcing the billionaire heir to run the pig farm while the pig farm owner has to navigate through the extravagant world. Each of them embarks on a completely different life...

name: Will You Marry Me?
summary: How far would you go to pop the question? Lovestruck Brits go to extreme lengths, as they hatch wild plans and head to spectacular locations to utter those four life-changing words...!

name: David Baddiel - The Not The Trilogy
summary:
All three of David Baddiel's universally critically acclaimed one-man shows will land on Sky Arts & NOW in November.  These first original stand-up commissions for Sky Arts will see My Family: Not the Sitcom premiere on Saturday 9 November, Fame: Not the Musical on 16 November and Trolls: Not the Dolls following on 23 November, all at 10pm on Sky Arts and available on NOW.
 

Taped at London's iconic Royal Court Theatre earlier this year, David reprised the three critically acclaimed shows which saw him return to stand up (after 15 years away) and perform in the UK and internationally from 2013 - 2021.

name: The Borderline
summary: A border town cop uncovers an illegal drug trade tied to his childhood friend and a ruthless British crime syndicate operating in the scenic 1000 Islands region between Canada and the U.S.

name: The Stanford Prison Experiment: Unlocking the Truth
summary: Through unparalleled access, The Stanford Prison Experiment: Unlocking the Truth embarks on a gripping, ticking-clock journey through the six-day Stanford Prison Experiment with a deluge of reveals, new subjects and a smoking-gun archive. The docuseries weaves together shocking, poignant and sometimes humorous firsthand accounts from the very participants who were at the heart of the experiment. Then, in an unexpected turn, the series brings the participants to a replica film set of the "prison," where they revisit pivotal moments and attempt to find consensus — and closure — about what really happened over the course of those six days.

name: Ash Holme: What Not To Do With Dad
summary: What Not To Do With Dad sees TikTok star and party-animal, Ash Holme take on the types of challenges you would never, EVER want your parent to know about. Only she's taking her dad, Phil, along for the ride.... How will they fare learning to pole dance? Visiting a sex club? Or double dating? And what will they discover about each other - and their relationship - in the process?

name: Alienated
summary: Teenage outcast Luna has difficulties fitting in at school. A loner, she is bullied and feels despised for being ‘ugly' and ‘poor'. She really wants everyone to like her - or at least Jake, whom she has a crush on. A freak accident one day forces her down an unexpected path through alternate realities in search of happiness, only to face dreadful consequences.

name: The Comeback: 2004 Boston Red Sox
summary: This definitive docuseries chronicles the Red Sox's journey to their first World Series title in 86 years via interviews with star players and personnel.

name: Найди по ID
summary: "Naydi po ID" is a real Internet investigation using the latest technology. Can you trust a distant relative who has reconnected with you after a long break? What to do if you have fallen in love with an online acquaintance, but she does not want to see you? Where to go if someone has stolen your candid photos and threatens to post them on the Internet? The host Nikolai Leibov has one answer to these and other questions - to figure out the secret ill-wisher and find out what the interlocutor on the other side of the screen is really up to.

name: Rap:Public
summary: RAP:PUBLIC invites you to a hip-hop survival world you have never seen before. It's a real hip-hop survival show where the participants compete and survive using rap as their weapon. The rappers form their own 'blocks' and compete as a team to survive in a society disconnected from the outside world. In this society where cooperation and competition coexist, they can only decide their fate through games that use rap. The final winning block will be given 300,000 dollars as a prize and become the first owner of RAP:PUBLIC.

name: Starlight Boys
summary: iQIYI's first original talent show a global male idol audition! Here, dazzling teenagers from all over the world gather to receive professional training at Starlight Academy, crossing the boundaries of language and culture, and igniting the stage with their talent and passion. Through fierce competition and teamwork, they will compete for the opportunity to become a globally recognized super idol. Let's witness how they are born from the starlight and become trendsetting stars!

previousepisode.name: Final Performance Live Broadcast-Nine Starlight Boys will debut as a group

name: KOKO
summary: The documentary series KOKO, about the Olympic, World and European champion athlete, presents the life of István Kovács Kokó in four parts. The still popular boxer tells the story of the highs and lows of his life and sporting career. You will meet the people who were influential in his life and hear from legends such as Imre Szántó (Uncle Öcsi), Dariusz Michalczewski and Vitalij Klicsko.

name: TV2 Titkok Ramónával
summary: TV2 Secrets with Ramóna is an exciting and unique podcast featuring in-depth interviews with famous people. We reveal the aspects and stories that remain hidden from the public eye. The show uncovers the reality behind the people, exploring the challenges, successes, failures, and moments that have shaped their lives. Each episode is an exciting journey behind the fame, helping us better understand and appreciate the individuals who have become part of our lives. Here, the curtain truly falls on everything! It's not just about asking questions; we have real conversations! – Hosted by Ramóna Kiss.

name: Stage Fighter
summary: Stage Fighter is a survival program in which male dancers from ballet, contemporary dance, and Korean traditional dance genres will compete against each other in a ranked battle. The dancers will combine their unique dance styles with modern and popular dance elements to present spectacular group performances.

name: Ratamo
summary: A fast-paced action-thriller about the Finnish Security Intelligence Service detective Arto Ratamo who is assigned a very delicate case that threatens the national security of Finland. The investigation gets complicated as it seems that the Prime Minister of Finland is either being blackmailed by a Russian oligarch - or has he leaked the classified information himself?

name: Charlie the Interviewer of Things
summary: A funny and clumsy sheep interviews all sorts of everyday objects.

name: Marry You
summary: Level seven government worker Jung Ha-na's dream is to retire peacefully, but her feisty attitude lands her in the Marriage Promotion Team at Injeong City Hall, a role she finds baffling as she doesn't believe in marriage herself. To make matters worse, her ex-boyfriend Ki-jun, whom she nearly married three years ago, appears as her new team leader, adding to her disbelief. Desperate to escape the team, Ha-na is tasked with marrying off local bachelor Cheol-hee. Though Cheol-hee initially refuses, believing he's not suited for marriage, Ha-na's determination gradually softens his heart. As they open up to each other, Ha-na and Cheol-hee, who both doubted their worthiness of marriage, find themselves questioning if they can take the plunge after all. Will Ha-na and Cheol-hee finally gather the courage to believe in love and marriage?

name: Contraband: Seized at the Airport
summary: Follows Dept of Homeland Security officers at five different airports across the country, from San Francisco, Detroit, Newark, Atlanta, and Honolulu, as they search for contraband both leaving and coming into the US.

name: Residential Rage
summary: See what happens when rage comes home, boiling over right on your front doorstep. Horrifying real stories of neighbors attacking each other after disagreements explode into violence. Shocking incidents of neighbors behaving badly, all caught on camera.

name: 90 Day: The Last Resort Between the Sheets
summary: 90 Day: The Last Resort Between the Sheets is an unfiltered, one-hour after-show that dives deeper into each week's episodes. Cast members from this season of 90 Day: The Last Resort will provide behind-the-scenes commentary and personal reflections on their experiences at the resort. Through never-before-seen footage, and unique therapist interviews, viewers will get an exclusive insider look at what really went down when the cameras were and weren't rolling. This has all the juicy secrets, hilarious anecdotes and emotional moments as your favorite couples dissect jaw dropping scenes.

name: Laid
summary: A woman finds out her former lovers are dying in unusual ways and must go back through her sex timeline to confront her past in order to move forward – "Laid" is a f*cked up rom-com where the answer to "why can't I find love, is there something wrong with me?" is a resounding "Yes. There is. The problem is definitely you."

name: Citizen Nation
summary: This four-part documentary series is an inspiring coming-of-age story that follows teenagers from across America as they face off in the nation's premier civics competition. Culminating in a championship showdown in the nation's capital, high school students with diverse personal and political backgrounds grapple with critical questions about democracy.

name: Family Guy Hulu Exclusives
summary: A series of exclusive 'Family Guy' specials that air only on Hulu.

previousepisode.name: Holiday Special 2025: Disney's Hulu's Family Guy's Hallmark Channel's Lifetime's Familiar Holiday Movie

name: Making Manson
summary: An explosive series offering unfiltered insights into America's most notorious killer, Charles Manson. Through 20 years' worth of never-before-aired conversations, those closest to the case have their views challenged as Manson talks openly about his part in the infamous crimes, as well as his upbringing, criminal youth and his true feelings about "The Family." Manson reveals the cruelty he suffered in reform school and the childhood experiences that made him who he was. Former "Family" members listen to the exclusive conversations and are taken back to the time when they "would do anything for Charlie." Manson recounts the early crimes that led to the murder spree in the summer of ‘69, laying out an explanation of loyalty and brotherhood that pushes against the accepted motive: his desire to incite Helter Skelter. In the final moments before his death, Manson reflects on his life in prison and shows rare tenderness for the man who spoke to him across the decades.

name: LOL: Last One Laughing Germany - Halloween Special
summary: To celebrate Halloween, LOL will be airing a surprise special edition of the show packed with unnaturally funny jokes! Michael Bully Herbig will be welcoming four eerie teams of two comprising Mirja Boes & Torsten Sträter, Palina Rojinski & Olaf Schubert, Annette Frier & Sasha, as well as Bill & Tom Kaulitz. Andthe rules are as follows: If somebody laughs, both members of the team are out!

name: Cold Case Files: The Grim Sleeper
summary: In Los Angeles in the 1980's, a killer terrorized South Central, murdering African American women and discarding their bodies in the street. Yet, as the victim count rose, there were few suspects leading to fear and anger in a community often overlooked by the LAPD. Eventually dubbed "The Grim Sleeper," this notorious killer went on to terrorize the neighborhood for decades until DNA technology allowed the LAPD to close in on the perpetrator. Featuring in depth interviews with survivors and victims' families, many speaking for the first time, as well as rare archival footage, "Cold Case Files: The Grim Sleeper" explores the personal stories of the victims who were all but forgotten by the police, the media and the community at large.

name: Dünentod - Ein Nordsee-Krimi
summary: As a rough guy, the idiosyncratic Tjark Wolf investigates in the rough landscape of East Frisia. At his side is the police chief Femke Folkmer, with whom he - of course - forms an unequal investigator duo. They make a grisly discovery on the North Sea coast - and little do they know that this will begin their collaboration in a series of murder cases that will push them to their limits - or even beyond.

name: I Kissed a Girl
summary: I Kissed a Girl promises to deliver all the romance, drama, and excitement that fans of the franchise have come to love. Set in an exotic location, the show follows a group of single queer women as they search for their perfect match, but with a twist: before any conversation, each girl is paired with their most compatible match, and their first interaction is a kiss. Will sparks fly, or will the chemistry fizzle out?

name: Evil Escapes
summary: Evil Escapes follows three disabled comedians as they take a spooky road trip across the UK and attempt to prank and out-scare each while exploring Britain's scariest and weirdest attractions.

name: Game Changers
summary: The history behind the most iconic games and how they went on to influence the world of pop culture and beyond will be explored in Game Changers, From Pong to Call of Duty and Monopoly to Minecraft,this eight-part limited series dives into the little-known backstories of how these wildly popular and successful games were created. Interviews with inventors, journalists, video game enthusiasts, authors and more reveal the brilliant inspiration and dirty deals that brought these games to the public.

name: Jerry Springer: Fights, Camera, Action
summary: Tension, trauma and toxic relationships — and that's just the producers. Uncover the secrets of the salacious talk show, told by the people who made it.

name: Штурм
summary: On the occasion of the Day of Defenders of Ukraine, ICTV presents the first Ukrainian action series Sturm about the work of a special SBU unit that counteracts the most serious crimes against the national security of Ukraine.

name: Face Me
summary: A medical mystery thriller that traces the truth of the incident of a famous plastic surgeon, who had a reputation as a righteous man, who fell into the abyss after being caught up in an unexpected incident and underwent reconstructive plastic surgery for crime victims.

name: My WeChat Connects to the Dragon Palace
Coming to Court Soon
summary: The show tells the story of Prosecutor Zhong Qinyang and Assistant Prosecutor Song Su, who uphold fairness and justice while handling a series of juvenile cases. Meanwhile, Zhong Qinyang befriends high school student Li Songyan and gradually uncovers the truth behind his parents' car accident. As the real culprit is brought to justice, everyone embarks on a new chapter of their lives under the warm light of justice.

name: Mary's Foolproof Dinners
summary: Mary shares her wit and wealth of cookery know-how with her celebrity pals, all keen to keep up in the kitchen. Success every time, in a joyful celebration of food with friends.

name: In Cold Water: The Shelter Bay Mystery
summary: On a fishing trip in the Canadian Rockies, schoolteacher Laura Letts-Beckett drowns under mysterious circumstances, leaving her husband, Peter, as the sole witness. What follows is so extraordinary that it's hard to believe this is a true story. A secret police investigation ensues, exposing additional murder allegations and questions about marriage, religion, suicide and a plot to kill witnesses.

name: Hard North
summary: Hard North, following a diverse group of young Canadians as they embark on a challenging four-season mission: to build a life in the vast and unforgiving Canadian wilderness. The series takes viewers on an adventure through some of the country's most remote and rugged landscapes as these aspiring homesteaders face the harsh realities of living off the land and strive to not just survive - but to thrive in these wild places, they now call home.

name: Пальцы
summary: Andrey, Kostya, Yura, Danya and Vitalik were best friends in the dashing 90s. The nickname Fingers quickly became attached to the teenagers, and the guys themselves were inspired by gangster romance. The lawlessness that reigned on the streets of the provincial Shubinskaya pushed them against local racketeers. The showdown resulted in death and criminal cases, and the gun was hidden in a hiding place. Only the Fingers knew about it, each of which went its own way. But 20 years later, the past catches up with the guys, and the trust between them collapses.

name: Большое переселение
summary: In the new reality show "The Big Relocation", the village family of the Morozovs will challenge the most glamorous and large family of show business - the family of Dzhigan and Oksana Samoilova. The Morozovs will go to live in the luxurious Dzhigan mansion, and the Dzhigan family will go to the village "apartments" of the Morozovs. Will those who are used to a luxurious life be able to adapt to the countryside? And will those who have never seen luxury be able to survive in luxury conditions? TNT will swap the two families and check out what came of it.

name: Qui non è Hollywood
summary: One of the most famous cases in Italian true crime involves the disappearance of a girl named Sarah.

name: Family Film And TV Awards
summary: At Family Film And TV Awards, we honor the timeless stories that remind us of the importance of family, no matter what form it takes. From classic TV series to our current favorites, these programs celebrate the bonds that unite us.

previousepisode.name: The 27th Family Film And TV Awards

name: Eat, Slay, Love
summary: Four celebrity friends take a girls trip to Vietnam to reinvigorate themselves, find new inspiration and celebrate a birthday. Nivea, Eva Marcille, Tammy Rivera and London Hughes travel through three regions of Vietnam, experiencing the culture and learning about one another. Along the way, cultural clashes and misunderstandings within the group lead to trouble early in the trip, and the ladies must figure out if they can get things back on track. The spirituality, hospitality and beauty of Vietnam help the ladies heal from heartache, strengthen friendships and reevaluate their priorities back at home.

name: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War
summary:
After an awe-inspiring battle with Ichibei Hyousube—leader of the Soul Society's Royal Guard—the powerful Yhwach moves into the final stage of his master plan. He aims to slay the Soul King, the being whose very existence maintains the status quo of three worlds: Hueco Mundo, the Soul Society, and the realm of humans that Ichigo Kurosaki and his closest friends hail from. Conquering his own bout with the remainder of the Royal Guard, Uryuu Ishida joins Yhwach in his efforts to create a new world in his image.

With a flood of resolution and newfound power, Ichigo rushes to stop Yhwach from accomplishing his ultimate goal and save the countless lives within the three existing realms. But Ichigo has a complicated lineage, one that leaves him susceptible to Yhwach's sinister influence.

Meanwhile, in a final desperate gambit, Jirou Sakuranosuke Shunsui Kyouraku, the newly promoted head captain of the Soul Society's combat corps, enlists the help of an old enemy whose immense power may turn the tide of battle.

name: Царица
summary: A trucker, a crane operator, an orphanage pupil, a housewife from a Kyrgyz village, a mother with many children and others - they are united by talent and a desire to sing on stage. Due to life circumstances, they could not start their star trek, but in a vocal show they will try to fulfill their dream.

name: Expedition Files
summary: In the all-new series Expedition Files, adventurer Josh Gates travels through history on a search to uncover new evidence and answers to the world's most captivating and unexplained mysteries.  Each episode of Expedition Files explores compelling true stories that defy explanation, offering stunning revelations and surprising new insights.

name: Лікарка за покликанням
summary: "The Doctor by Vocation" is a Ukrainian series based on the story of Ohmatdyt's life during the first 50 days of the full-scale invasion. The series tells the story of a talented doctor who, amid a family crisis, decides to stay in Ukraine and work in a hospital during the war. Despite personal dramas and difficult conditions, she and her colleagues tirelessly save patients' lives.

name: Press Start!
summary: Sunny and his sister Rue are all about the exciting, fast-paced world of "24 KARAT QUEST" video game. Athletic, brave and funny, Super Rabbit Boy is the hero of this fantastical Game-World. When the siblings end up able to play IN the game, their life is flipped upside down.

name: Stefan und Bully gegen irgendson Schnulli
summary: For the first time ever, entertainment heavyweights Stefan Raab and Michael 'Bully' Herbig are competing as a duo on a game show. Who will come out on top? Their opponents could be tradesmen, doctors, students, teachers or lawyers. Raab and Bully will compete against the candidate who manages to beat three other contestants at the start of the show. Elton will host the new show, with Frank Buschmann providing commentary.

name: Такое видео
summary: We live in a world of amazing and incredible phenomena that no one can explain. Secrets of nature, messengers from other worlds, mysterious animals and people with superpowers surround us in everyday life, and sometimes we don't even know about it. Our mission is to introduce you to them and teach you how to resist them. After all, there is only one way to protect yourself from them. It's laughter. Sincere and unstoppable.

name: An Poitín
summary:
In this comedy-drama series, we are introduced to Braon Poitín. A curious but talented man, struggling to make his own way in the world, decides to bring his poitín business to the international market - whichever way he can. 

Braon believes he will be able to save the world with this miracle liquid and pushes the patience of his family and community to the end of their tether as he embarks on his questionable business through dubious marketing ideas.

name: Anti-Fraud
summary: Reckless thrill-seeker Qin Lang has only one dream, become a narcotics officer, yet on graduation he's dumped into the Anti-Fraud Center. To transfer out faster, he's forced to partner with the icy, razor-sharp Gao Man, and the two become instant frenemies. Case by case, their crackdowns shatter fraud rings, and Qin starts to feel the pull of this new battlefield, until the day he discovers that the fraud syndicate's kingpin is inextricably linked to the drug lord he's sworn to take down.

name: The Fevengers
summary: After a kidnapping, jewelry heiress Wen Ruojun discovers that her husband, Gu Yancheng, not only cheated with her best friend but that their entire marriage was a carefully crafted scheme to seize her wealth. Awakening to the truth, Wen Ruojun finds Lin Jiayi, another of his victims, and the two women join forces with others to launch their revenge against Gu Yancheng!

name: ShenDu Fox Detective
summary: A series of gruesome murders targeting young women sends Luoyang City into panic. Hu Zhengyi, a Dali Temple, is tasked with uncovering the truth. Meanwhile, rogue swordsman Li Jianxing deliberately approaches Hu to investigate his own family's massacre. From "Phoenix Murders" to "Puppet Brides," the duo navigates surreal cases, transforming from mutual suspicion to life-and-death allies in their pursuit of justice.

name: I Am Not Your Enemy
summary: Mi Youchu, a general's daughter, marries the heir Su Buxiao out of love, but suffer from betrayal and the destruction of her family. Reborn with revenge in her heart, she hones her skills to take down Su Buxiao—unaware that his body now hosts a game player trying to win her love. What begins as a deadly chase turns into a reluctant partnership when a mysterious figure threatens her family again. Forced to work together, they share laughs, survive danger, and slowly fall for each other, uncovering the truth—and love—along the way.

name: Agarwood Like a Dream
summary: To clear her late mother's name, the genius perfumer Ying Hemeng marries into her enemy's house, and becomes the concubine of the heir, Ye Buhuan. The two of them, each with their own agenda, have several confrontations and gradually develop feelings in the midst of their probing and scheming. Together, amidst a mixture of love and hatred, they unravel the truth of the past together.

name: Call Me Ted
summary: The life and legacy of Ted Turner is told in his own words in this six-part documentary series.

name: Love Island VIP
summary: A group of adventurous VIP singles experience a summer full of exciting encounters and tingling flirts in a luxurious villa. Presenter Sylvie Meis leads the first VIP version of the successful dating show.

name: The Empress of Ayodhaya
summary: Jinda, daughter of the lord of Lopburi, and excellent in appearance and intellect, was born to the highest of destinies. It is her great duty to seize the throne from Phra Chairacha, the warrior king of Ayodhaya, and return it to her own Lavo dynasty line. Jinda must therefore offer herself as one of four royal concubines, inevitably separating her from her lover Wamon. Her journey has her face the other three royal concubines of foreign origin, Jittrawadi, La-ongkham, and Tanyong, each vying for the position of queen consort.

name: 13 Клиническая. Начало
summary: USSR, 1970s. The world's first mystical hospital opens its doors to the demonically possessed. Doctor Yana heads the clinic to return her son, who was kidnapped by otherworldly forces.

name: It's in the Game: Madden NFL
summary: It's in the Game: Madden NFL reveals the never-been-told story of Madden NFL, from its archaic 8-bit origins to its success as an annual must have—against all odds.  For the first time ever, EA SPORTS is opening their vault of rare and never-been-seen footage, while also allowing cameras to follow along as the team finishes the next generation of the game. What started as an unlikely pairing between a computer whiz and a football legend, ignited a revolution and triggered a seismic collision between the worlds of jocks and geeks. They should have failed. Instead, their game changed the game—and our culture, too.

previousepisode.name: We Are Definitely in the Fourth Quarter

name: Society of Virtue
summary: Adventures of the greatest heroes, facing the problems you probably didn't even know they had... and maybe would rather not know.

name: PwC All Stars Awards
summary: Joanne Cantwell and Marty Morrissey presents live coverage from the RDS of the PwC All Star Awards 2024.

name: US Presidential Election Special
summary: Live results coverage of the US presidential election, presented by Miriam O'Callaghan in Washington and David McCullagh in Dublin.

name: The Choice 2024
summary: Investigating the lives and characters of the US presidential and vice presidential candidates as they seek office. In an historic election, those who know the candidates best reveal key moments that shape how they would lead America.

previousepisode.name: The VP Choice: Vance vs Walz

name: The Groomsmen
summary: The Groomsmen follows Danny, Jackson, and Pete as they stand by each other through the biggest days of their lives. The narrative explores their complex relationships with friends, love interests, and family members, all while celebrating the bond of their enduring friendship. The Groomsmen trilogy offers a unique perspective on these significant life events, making it a must-watch for fans.

name: Beyond: UFOs and the Unknown
summary: Following revelations of a secret government program studying UFOs, many experts have stopped asking whether UFOs are real and have started wondering: "what are they?" The answer could change everything we thought we knew about human consciousness.

name: Cinema Therapy
summary: Do movies help you to heal? To grow? To connect? Licensed therapist Jonathan Decker and professional filmmaker Alan Seawright draw from their experiences on the job to explore the psychology of your favorite films! Your "Internet Dads" combine humor, heart, and vulnerability to share healthy relationship skills, mental health awareness, and movie-making magic.

previousepisode.name: Therapist Reacts to CLOUDY WITH A CHANCE OF MEATBALLS

name: Cuisine Ouverte
summary: Showcases the heritage and diversity of French cuisine through a friendly and inventive exchange between cuisine from our regions and cuisine open to influences from around the world, led by chef Mory Sacko.

previousepisode.name: Port de Binic, tartare de criste marine avec Riad Sattouf

name: Señales Del Más Allá
summary: Paranormal investigator Alberto del Arco explores the sites of Mexico's most haunting crimes and tragedies.

name: Makinium
summary: Three friends inhabit an almost desert planet, whose only forest is locked behind a wall, built by the masters of the galaxy: the Majestic. But the three heroes find a secret passage that leads to the forest, and discover that the Majesties have a secret base there! What are they looking for? And who is this strange creature in the forest?

name: One in a Hundred
summary:
Despite initial misunderstandings and reservations from their families, Wichai and Anong find comfort in each other's company. Anong is a high-society lady whom many men compete for, given her status, it's important that her family finds her a good match. Passionate lawyer Wichai finds himself randomly tasked with screening potential husbands for her. His duty is to eliminate unsuitable candidates and pave the way for his younger brother. However, Wichai redefines what it means to be worthy, leading Anong to realize that no one is more suitable than Wichai himself. He only sees her, however, as a sister-in-law. Anong attempts to win his heart, even if there's only a "one in a hundred" chance that a confident woman such as she could land a saint like him.

~~ Adapted from the novel "Nueng Nai Roi" (หนึ่งในร้อย) by Dok Mai Sod (ดอกไม้สด).

name: Štaflík a Špagetka
summary: The show stars two dogs: Štaflík, a tall white dog and Špagetka, a long black dog. They go on various adventures but they often get distracted by a crow.

name: Här är ditt kylskåp
summary: Here's Your Fridge is based on Taylor visiting some of the country's most popular figures in their homes, where together they take on the task of cooking a three-course meal using only the ingredients already in the fridge. Although the concept rests on the cooking arrangement, it is a program that is at least as much about Taylor as the viewers getting to know the celebrities in a new way.

name: Cromañón: La noche del incendio
summary: The drama series follows a group of teenage friends whose lives are impacted by the real-life fire that erupted at the República Cromañón club in Buenos Aires in 2004. The story is told from the perspective of Malena, a 19-year-old aspiring musician. On the night of the fire, Malena attends her favorite rock band's concert with her friends, unaware she will lose many of her loved ones at that event. Four years later, she returns to her childhood neighborhood to reconcile with her past and overcome the guilt she feels about surviving the tragic fire.

name: Bureau Maastricht
summary: Ewout spent six months working with the police in the Limburg capital. The presenter once again follows six couples who provide emergency services, day and night. Various cases are discussed, from a runaway dog to domestic violence and from exciting chases in collaboration with the Belgian police, to people with suicidal thoughts and confused people walking around with dangerous weapons.

name: На двоих не делится
summary:
Lida and Masha Soykin are sisters, but, as often happens, they are completely different in character. The feisty and independent Lida is married, raising her daughter Varya and owns a sewing business, while the modest Masha has no job, no family, only loans and a dissolute lover, Vadim.

Blackmailing Masha by breaking up, Vadim draws her into crime - they kidnap Varya in the hope of a ransom from the rich Lida. The kidnapping of the child reveals a tangle of family secrets, which begins to unravel dramatically and unpredictably, revealing the unsightly truth. The sisters will have to go through a difficult path to save the girl, understand and accept each other.

name: За день до...
summary:
The author of the most popular romance novels, Alexander Kostrov, writing under a female pseudonym, after an accidental electric shock receives a mystical ability to see future crimes, namely, the details of a murder that has not yet been committed, but has already been predetermined.

Alexander, having learned from the news about the death of a young teacher in a city park, understands that he observed the details of this particular crime in his vision. The writer comes to the Investigative Committee and, introducing himself as a "witness", gives testimony to the Investigative Committee employee Victoria Lunina.

name: Детектив на кончике пера
summary: Varya Lyubochkina writes women's novels. Her books sell well, but she would like to write detective stories. Varya's younger brother, Nikita, works in the local department of the Investigative Committee. His boss, Pyotr Kravtsov, entrusts him with a delicate matter - to find Yulia Filippova, the runaway fiancée of the son of a famous businessman. Nikita goes looking for Yulia and disappears. Varya rushes to find him. Using the laws of dramaturgy, she manages not only to find her brother, but also to solve the murder of the fiancée.

name: Вишенка на торте
summary: Anna is getting ready for her wedding. The groom is a positive, wealthy man, although a bit of a bore, but is that a big problem? One day, Anna gets a call from her ex-mother-in-law: her son suddenly left without explaining anything. And she is sure that her apartment is being watched. She is afraid to go out even for groceries...

name: Ikke et ord
summary: Life in the small provincial town of Vesterløv goes well for Charlotte and her family, but when 19-year-old Liam from the local wrestling team is found dead, and Charlotte's husband, the town's wrestling coach, Lars, is arrested for the murder, everything changes for Charlotte and their already shaky marriage is put to the test.

name: Found & Lost
summary: In the early years of the Republic of China, Su Manli, a stand-in dancer at the XianYuess Club, crosses paths with Chen Bi, a noblewoman whose family has been tragically wiped out, while searching for her father's killer. Borrowing Chen Bi's identity, Su Manli approaches Yang Ziqin, a council member of the Haitang Society, to uncover the truth behind the Chen family massacre. Upon learning Yang Ziqin's true identity, the three join forces to confront the mastermind behind it all.

name: Wen Chu Na Lai Qing Ruxu
Parole Examiner Lee
summary: Parole Examiner Lee follows lawyer Lee Han Shin, who becomes a parole officer responsible for making final decisions on inmate paroles. Lee Han Shin is determined to prevent inmates who show little remorse for their crimes from obtaining paroles through money, connections, or deceitful tactics.

name: Итоги с Малькевичем
summary: Everything that happened in Russia and in the world will be told in the final weekly analytical program by the famous Russian journalist Alexander Malkevich.

name: Desde la Raíz
summary: Desde la Raíz is a captivating four-part series that dives deep into the essence of Mexican culture by exploring four iconic products. From the ancient origins of corn to the fiery allure of chili, from the aromatic richness of coffee to the mystique of mezcal, this series celebrates the flavors, aromas, and stories that shape Mexico's cultural identity. Each episode offers an immersive journey through the rich history, cherished traditions, and bright future of these quintessential elements.

name: Муж напрокат
summary: The show's heroes are spouses who have encountered various problems in their relationships. Each of them has accumulated many complaints over the years of their family life, which, having reached a critical mass, threaten to destroy the once happy marriage. The heroes will be able to spend several days with those partners who seem ideal to them. Where is it easier to breathe, in the family or in freedom? And is the new relationship as good as it seems at first glance? In order to be objective to the issue of old and new relationships, the function of an arbitrator will be performed by a mediator - professional psychologist Inna Chudinova, who will monitor everything that happens.

name: Is It Cake? Holiday
summary: Talented bakers, unbelievable illusions and joyful holiday vibes. Is It Cake? Holiday brings back nine All Star bakers from past seasons for the ultimate holiday showdown. Across four episodes, watch as bakers return to craft tasty replicas of ice skates, wreaths, nutcrackers and more in this holiday spin on the mind-bending baking competition. Bakers will baffle the celebrity judges with their festive and delicious deceptions and fight their way to the ultimate grand prize.

name: All in – Marbella
summary: It will be some memorable days for both the participants and the viewers, when celebrities from Paradise hotel, among others, will spend six days together in idyllic surroundings. On the last and sixth day, a winner will be chosen, and it is based on stars that the celebrities themselves have awarded.

name: Welcome to the Occult Forest
summary: After watching a video online about a supposed real life supernatural occurrence, a horror film Director and his Assistant Director visit the house where said supposed occurrence took place with the intentions of filming a movie. Soon unexplainable phenomena begins to happen, so the Director sets out to document them and compile them into the most authentic horror film ever.

name: Hvem dater hvem?
summary: Five couples will live together for 24 hours, be social detectives and try to guess who is together, without being revealed themselves. Be prepared for a day full of strategy, lies and memorable participants.

name: After School Doctor
summary: An outrageous doctor arrives at the clinic of an elementary school. His hair disheveled and constantly looking sullen, Dr. Makino is a "physician" by profession. "Don't get on the bed without permission!" "As much as possible, try not to come to the clinic." "What a hassle! Is this even my job?!" Blunt and always complaining, Dr. Makino is a scary school physician who glares at everyone, be it the teachers or the children. But with his exceptional observation skills, he detects anomalies in the students and saves them, as well as their families and at times, the teachers. Set in an elementary school, this human drama features Dr. Makino, a mouthy pediatrician with a big attitude. Follow him as he uses his observation skills to detect the children's unspoken cries for help and offers them encouragement.

previousepisode.name: Take a good look. At your friends and at yourself.

name: Exclusive Love
summary: Wang Zhan , a timid, ghost-fearing successor of a funeral service company, meets Tang Du Zhi, a top-tier funeral director. As Tang puts him through rigorous training, their relationship unexpectedly deepens despite the challenges. Meanwhile, heartbroken wedding planner Zhang Yi Qing is tasked with organizing a wedding for his long-time crush, Tu Jing He, all while secretly planning to sabotage it! Between the events of funerals and weddings, these four characters confront past wounds and misunderstandings, redefining love and life in the process.

previousepisode.name: Just so you become exclusively mine

name: [Oshi no Ko]
summary:
Two pop idol Ai fans are reincarnated as her "secret" baby twins, Aqua and Ruby, and grow up supporting her until the tragic day she is stabbed by a stalker. Flash forward a few years later and Aqua and Ruby are high school students determined to make it on their own in the cutthroat world of entertainment for personal reasons.

The ending of this drama is told in "Oshi no Ko: The Final Act" (2024) theatrical movie.

name: Brekket
summary: Henrik, Jonis and Martin will fulfill a childhood dream: to rob a bank! Ten participants fight to be with the boys on the break.

name: Hellerud­svingen
summary: Erlend Mørch and Steinar Klouman Hallert present: «Hellerudsvingen». A modern masterpiece, or just junk? Judge for yourself.

name: Superskrekk
summary: Marius gets a job as a night watchman at NRK the week before Halloween. He is unaware of the ghouls that awaken beneath the basement and must be fought.

name: Flukten fra Bolivia
summary: In "Flukten fra Bolivia" we are drawn into a fight for survival. Ida, her sister-in-law Michelle and Ida's lover Cecilie are brutally arrested at the airport in Bolivia, accused of smuggling cocaine. The three girls are sentenced to life behind bars in one of the country's poorest women's prisons. Ida quickly realizes that she is surrounded by lies and betrayal, and that no one – not even those closest to her – can be trusted. She is hoping for help from the Norwegian authorities, but instead, help appears from an unexpected source that gives her a chance. A newly established men's magazine has a bold plan to help her escape. Under the protection of a mercenary and with her newborn child in her arms, Ida makes the ultimate choice. She puts her life on the line and embarks on a dangerous escape through the jungles of South America.

name: Zombie Animals
summary: Nature is awe-inspiring and beautiful, but also can be terrifying. Mind-controlling parasites, virulent viruses and freaky fungi - Dan O'Neill reveals the astonishing world of animal invaders.

name: The Love We Couldn't Keep
summary: The cold-hearted Tang Weiwei falls in love with intern Li Shu under a misunderstanding and a series of unfortunate events. Just as Tang Weiwei is basking in happiness, she learns that Li Shu is the younger brother of her deceased first love, and his appearance was part of a plan for revenge. After clearing up the misunderstanding, the two choose to break up. Years later, they meet again on the street...

name: Million Dollar Listing India
summary: The 2-time Emmy nominated series is now in India! The stakes are high for six real estate professionals who handle multi-million-dollar properties in some of India's most exclusive neighbourhoods. Juggling market fluctuations, intense negotiations and high-pressure deadlines, can these realtors bag the next big deal?

name: Ant Anstead: Born Mechanic
summary: Master mechanic Ant Anstead goes back to basics as he buys, restores and sells old cars from a ramshackle barn. But this time, it's personal, as any profit made will help him renovate a 500-year-old farmhouse that he's bought for his parents to retire in.

name: Beyond Chelsea
summary: Follow Made in Chelsea OGs Binky Felstead, Lucy Watson and Rosie Fortescue in a reality spin-off, as they navigate new challenges and major milestones, from starting families to building businesses.

name: Lovec
summary:
The series follows Tomáš, a demon hunter working for a secret order. He does order's will and believes that he is on the right side, although he has doubts about some of the habits and methods of his organization. During his work he helps police to investigate mysterious cases associated with mysterious and inexplicable phenomena and fights demons as he tries to maintain the balance between good and evil.

Alice is a manager at insurance company. She starts having dreams when a murder occurs at Tribeč Mountains and doesn't know if her dreams are just dreams or visions. The murder is similar to murder of her mother that happened thirty years ago and her father was convicted for it. For years she blamed him for what he supposedly did. However, her father denies the guilt and cannot explain what happened in front of his eyes at that time. At the crime scene she unexpectedly meets Tomáš and soon afterwards she gets in contact with a demon who enters inside her but she doesn't become possessed by him which never happened before. Tomáš believes that this is a new chance and that Alice can become a new weapon in an unequal battle. Therefore, he decides to protect her even from the very organisation of which he is a member and invites her to join him in his work.

name: Even Given the Worthless [Appraiser] Class I'm Actually the Strongest
summary: In a fantasy world where "jobs" are god-given from birth, heroes are born, not made...and Ein's job of "Appraiser" has put him about as far from the "hero" pedestal as possible. Used, abused, and eventually abandoned by his fellow adventurers, Ein decides it just isn't worth going on... Lucky for Ein, though, the end may just be the beginning...and a new lease on life. Turns out, his "worthless" job may just be the key to becoming a hero after all...

name: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
summary: "I've come to eat you." So softly utters the mermaid Shiori as she emerges from the sea and takes high school girl Hinako by the hand. Hinako lives alone in a town by the sea and possesses an unusually delicious body that is irresistible to nearby monsters. To ensure that she matures to the best condition, Shiori seeks to protect Hinako—all so that someday, she can devour every piece of her. What will become of Hinako's feelings as this looming unjust death closes in on her...?

name: Pass the Monster Meat, Milady!
summary: Any proper noble lady must cultivate refined tastes, and Lady Melphiera's delicacy of choice is…monsters! Unfortunately, society frowns upon such unladylike cravings and brands her the "Voracious Villainess." At a banquet, she's attacked by a monster, only to be saved by the feared "Blood-Mad Duke." He's brutal, mysterious, and charming. Could he be the one to appreciate her monstrous appetite?

name: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé and Sold to Another Kingdom
summary: Philia Adenauer protected her kingdom as a Saint until her engagement ended and she was sold to Parnacorta.

previousepisode.name: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé, Now in Another Kingdom

name: I'm the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!
summary: In his past life, Liam was hardworking and honest. This got him nothing but debt and betrayal. Now he's been reborn as the ruling noble of a planet. Time for some payback. This life he'll grind the world under his heel! He's only looking out for himself. All his underlings will suffer! But try as he might, his tyranny only seems to make his subjects happier.

name: The Holy Grail of Eris
summary: Constance, the daughter to a Viscount whose only value is her honesty, and Scarlet Castiel, the most reviled villainess of the era who was sentenced to death ten years ago. When the two people who were never supposed to meet encountered one another at a night party, the story that should have ended with Scarlet's death began anew. Although their relationship only began out of mutual interest, they soon became true partners in an effort to unravel the mysteries of a grand conspiracy borne out of the past, that still has a vicious grip on the present.

previousepisode.name: The Final Chapter: At the Grand Merillian

name: Blade & Bastard
summary: Deep in the unexplored reaches of the dungeon, a corpse is discovered—one that shouldn't exist. After Iarumas is resurrected, his memories of life before death are gone, and he spends his days delving into the dungeon to retrieve the bodies of dead adventurers. Can they be revived as well? Or will God reduce them to piles of ash on the altar? Either way, Iarumas collects his finder's fee. And though his skills earn him some grudging respect, he's also scorned for this cold, utilitarian attitude. The living keep their distance—Iarumas consorts primarily with the dead. That is, until he meets Garbage, a feral young swordswoman who's the sole survivor of a massacred party. With Garbage by his side, Iarumas ventures deeper, scouring the dungeon for clues to his past, avoiding monsters, traps, and the inevitability of a permanent ashen demise.

name: Bogus Skill "Fruitmaster" About that time I became able to eat unlimited numbers of Skill Fruits (that kill you)
summary: In a world where Skill Fruits grant powers, aspiring adventurer Light is stuck with the useless <<Fruitmaster>> skill. Eating another one results in death, so no do-overs. Meanwhile, his childhood friend Rena quickly rises to S Rank. But when Light accidentally eats a second Skill Fruit, he survives and discovers his true power: He can consume unlimited Skill Fruits and gain their abilities!

name: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman
summary: Beryl Gardinant, a self-proclaimed "humble old man," is a sword instructor at his dojo in a rural, backwater village. In his younger years, he dreamed of glory as a master swordsman, but those days are long behind him. Out of the blue, he receives a visit from a famous former pupil who brings him world-shattering news - he's been appointed as a special instructor for the knights of the Liberion Order! With his life now turned upside down, Beryl travels to the capital and reunites with some of his former students: elite knights, an ace wizard, and even an adventurer who's attained the highest guild rank possible. But why do they all want his tutelage?! As far as he's concerned, they clearly don't need him anymore. Can Beryl live up to his new position? And will he ever get a moment's peace away from his adoring students?!

previousepisode.name: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes Home

name: Vencer o Morir
summary: Under the regime of Augusto Pinochet in Chile, a group of young people declares war on the dictator. Their leaders are commanders Tamara and Rodrigo. Both leave behind their lives and families to fight against the dictatorship; together, they aim to change Chile and its history.

name: Tie Eedeniin
summary: What is the mystical Eerola syndrome that threatens the future of members of a paradisiacal village community? The researcher couple returns to their home region to seek a profit from death by high-tech means. The domestic drama series Road to Eden tells about the pharmaceutical business, family conflicts and human relationships.

name: Rakastuin mä luuseriin
summary: Story of five upper secondary students depicted respectively from five different points of view.

name: Antiikkieno
summary: Oswald is an antique dealer with life on the line. My sister Emma suddenly pops into the shop to beg for a place to stay. Oswald promises accommodation for two nights. Creta's sister's tantrum changes Emma's overnight stay permanently, as Oswald-eno will do anything to make her sister's anger grow. A colorful coexistence begins, both at home and in the store.

name: Oiii's naturpatrulje finner kryp
summary: With nature guide Bjørn Henrik Stavdal Johansen at the head of Oiii's nature patrol, eight pairs of children go on an expedition in the harsh Norwegian nature to find wild crawling insects and insects.

name: Investigation Alien
summary: In this gripping docuseries, legendary reporter George Knapp travels the globe to uncover new evidence about UFOs and investigate their presence on Earth.

name: James May and the Dull Men
summary:
James May was recently introduced to the online phenomenon of ‘Dull Men's' forums, a place where men (and some women) ask questions most of us never thought to ask: "Can you cook dinner in your washing machine whilst cleaning your whites? "Is it possible to solve Britain's pothole problem once and for all?" 

These so-called ‘boring blokes' tinker away in their sheds, dreaming up solutions to problems like these. But James also has a shed, and he too spends a lot of time thinking about how small feats of engineering and ingenuity could solve our everyday irks…Now, from his home, shed and the pub he owns in Wiltshire, James embarks on a glorious ‘summer of dull'. 

Immersing himself in the threads on these forums, he'll seek to create his own ‘genius' solutions and prove that these ‘mundane men' are in fact, anything but dull.

name: Sold on SLC
summary: With impressive high-end properties and Salt Lake City's LDS community as the backdrop, Sold on SLC follows the layered social dynamics within the brokerage as the agents navigate complicated relationships and personal rivalries. Always on a mission for commission, drama often follows the fierce professional ambitions of the team as they strive to stay on top, and continue to raise the bar, in one of the fastest growing housing markets in the nation.

previousepisode.name: Thou Shalt Not Break Thy Broker

name: Stealth
summary: Ambitious and cunning girl Song Yiyi entered the Yulin Group to fulfill her mother's dying wish. Yet she faced her uncle Xue Fanyu's forceful eviction. A tug-of-war between mentoring and reverse mentoring ensued between the girl and the elder man, unraveling amidst the unknown grudges of the wealthy elite…

name: Claw Hunters
summary: Claw Hunters follows five bold lobster harvesters as they navigate the extreme weather of the North Atlantic in search of red gold.

name: Alien Corridors
summary: There are recordings of possible UFO and UAP sightings across the world which have created patterns. Alien Corridors investigates whether the Earth is being mapped by intergalactic forces. A team of multi-disciplined experts - believers and critics - investigates what these Alien Corridors are and what they mean.

name: Tigers Sniff the Rose
summary: Tells the story of Mu Wanyao, a noble daughter unwilling to accept her fate, and Yan Shang, a brilliant young man from a humble background. Together, they fight to build a peaceful world. Amidst the chaos of a troubled era, can their dreams come true?

name: Off Shoot
summary: A photographer and his assistant navigate wild and unpredictable clients in their Los Angeles studio.

name: Mysteries Unearthed with Danny Trejo
summary: Mysteries Unearthed with Danny Trejo examines the fascinating stories surrounding buried artifacts and lost civilizations, shedding light, and offering new insight and information, on various mysteries of the past and present. Anchored by Trejo's affinity for history and his natural curiosity into exploring the unknown and coupled with captivating archival material, expert interviews, and compelling recreations, the series seeks to unearth what the human eye cannot easily detect, as objects, structures and creatures concealed under earth, ice and water are suddenly, and often accidentally, revealed. From ancient animals uncovered as permafrost melts to excavations that make international headlines, each episode explains the significance of these discoveries and offers surprising context to these amazing finds. What exciting revelations can these preserved objects expose about our history and the legends and myths that surround them?

name: Crá
summary: An engrossing mystery unfolds set in the remote northwest of Ireland, Crá, follows Garda Conall Ó Súilleabháin as he searches for justice in the most personal of cases—the murder of his own mother, Sabine, whose body is discovered 15 years after her disappearance. Forbidden from joining the investigation, Conall partners with a determined young journalist, Ciara-Kate, who is using her true-crime podcast to expose the village's deepest secrets. As they unravel the truth, they must confront a community bound by silence and its own moral codes.

name: Funday Football
summary:
Each player will appear as a motion-enabled, animated player for the special primetime matchup. Through state-of-the-art tracking technology enabled by NFL's Next Gen Stats, Sony's Beyond Sports, combined with Sony's Hawk-Eye Innovations' optical tracking, fans enjoyingFunday Football will see every snap, run, pass, score and more from the real-life matchup at Stadium as it happens.

Sony's Beyond Sports makes it possible to combine two data sources, analyze, validate, enhance, translate to a 3D environment and stream to a desired platform in real-time and Sony's Hawk-Eye Innovations' optical tracking creates dynamic player and character movement including detailed limb movement and mannerisms.

name: Uusi päivä
summary: The residents of fictional city, Virtaus, young and old, experience their lives, joys and sorrows

name: Музыка времени
summary: Young members of a unique musical group from different cities and countries rehearse and write songs online. Their cherished dream is to meet live and perform on the stage of a big rock festival in Moscow. But in order for it to come true, they will have to face the misunderstanding of their parents, the betrayal of loved ones, rethink life values and overcome inner fears. Especially their soloist, Vasilisa, a Moscow schoolgirl, who dreams of a musical career, but has suffered from a pathological fear of public speaking since childhood - peyraphobia.

name: Vihreät Valot – Väärät bileet
summary: They should never have gone to that party. The members of the Green Lights band are arrested on suspicion of a serious crime. The investigators reveal a network of lies that young adults of the band have become entangled in over the past week. Who can you trust anymore?

name: Fleadh Cheoil
summary: When Fleadh Cheoil na hÉireann was staged in Cavan in 1954 it was a modest event attracting musicians and spectators in their hundreds. 57 years on Cavan hosted the Fleadh, for the second year in succession, this time attracting many thousands of musicians and visitors from many parts of the world. Presented by John Creedon and Aoibhinn Ní Shúilleabháin, Fleadh Cheoil captures the fun, excitement and good music from one of the biggest and longest running free music festivals in the world.

name: Uusi Päivä: Mä voin selittää kaiken
How to Survive a Dictator
summary: Satirist Munya Chawawa explores the lives of some of the world's most notorious tyrants.

name: Universe League
summary: The Universe League, which will create a boy group, it's a league-style audition where the final winning team that wins the Prism Cup debuts. Three representative K-pop artists will become the managers of each club. They select team members through a trainee draft and compete against each other. This was combined with the sports element of combining the best members of each club through a trade of exchanging trainees. Through this, 'Universe League' is expected to be a differentiated audition that shows more dynamic competition.

name: Franky snow
summary: Passionate about skiing and extreme sports, Franky Snow loves thrills. With his sidekicks, Zack and Ben, he tries to take up all the challenges.
